## Batch 1 of 17 — Issues #2, #13, #18, #29, #37

These are the **oldest issues** (pre-2026, original engineering debt). All received **triage stubs** rather than full implementation plans because their original descriptions are 1–3 lines from project inception. They need a triage decision: **scope or close**.

### #2 — `engg debt | wind | data APIs`
> "Get wind farm and structural data from public sources"

**Triage call:** worldenergydata has a `wind` module placeholder but no active wind data work. Likely **superseded** by metocean adapter (#268) and current data priorities. Recommendation: **close** with a note that wind farm data is deferred / out of current scope.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/2)

### #13 — `engg debt | Structures Data`
> "Get pipeline data with OD, WT, design Pressure, operating pressure, test pressure etc."

**Triage call:** Pipeline structural data is actively tracked under `pipeline_safety` module + #366 HSE ingest. Recommendation: **close** with a pointer to those active issues.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/13)

### #18 — `engg debt | TXRRC | Data`
> "Review if any useful data from `github.com/mlbelobraydi/TXRRC_data_harvest`"

**Triage call:** Texas RRC data is now a first-class module (`texas_rrc`) per the manifest. Recommendation: **close** with a pointer to the existing module + #354 manifest entry. The external repo review is no longer the path.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/18)

### #29 — `BSEE | APM Data`
> "Assess APM (Applications for Permit to Modify) data and get type of maintenance operation and actual duration"

**Triage call:** This is a **substantive ask** with SME feedback. Subsea wells + MODU/Cat B/RLWI vessel scope. This may still be relevant — APM data isn't currently in the BSEE module schema. Recommendation: **scope** — promote to a proper plan, file as a new BSEE module enhancement, or close as deferred.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/29)

### #37 — `Field Reserve Map`
> "Create a geo map showing Jack/St. Malo/Julia/Walker Ridge blocks"

**Triage call:** Specific Lower Tertiary block visualization. The LT epic (#373–#377) closed without delivering a block-level map. Could be a small, useful follow-up. Recommendation: **scope** as a quick `lower_tertiary` reporting task, or close as covered by the comprehensive HTML report.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/37)

---

- **Approve to implement:** `gh issue edit <N> --remove-label status:plan-review --add-label status:plan-approved`
- **Close as superseded/deferred:** `gh issue close <N> --comment "<reason>"`
- **Skip for now** — leave as plan-review and we'll come back

## Batch 3 of 17 — Issues #125, #126, #127, #128, #129

**Theme:** all 5 are WRK data-ingestion tasks for worldenergydata. These have proper missions (unlike batch 1) and represent real, actionable work.

### #125 — `WRK-1191: Ingest ERA5 reanalysis metocean`
> Mission: Ingest ECMWF ERA5 climate reanalysis (wind, wave, pressure) via CDS API for metocean design conditions. **Complexity: high.**

**Triage call:** Substantive metocean data work. Requires ECMWF CDS API key. Overlaps in scope with #268 (Open-Meteo) but ERA5 is more authoritative for design conditions. Recommendation: **scope as future** — flesh out a real plan with credential requirements. Implementation depends on having a CDS account.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/125)

### #126 — `WRK-1192: Ingest CMEMS ocean physics`
> Mission: Ingest Copernicus Marine (CMEMS) currents/temperature/salinity at 1/12° resolution. **Complexity: high.**

**Triage call:** High-value but credential-required (CMEMS account). Same scoping concern as #125 — needs detailed plan + credentials. Recommendation: **scope as future** or close as deferred until metocean roadmap is committed.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/126)

### #127 — `WRK-1204: Ingest rig metadata from state railroad commissions`
> Mission: Ingest individual rig names/contractors/metadata from TX RRC, NDIC, COGCC. **Complexity: medium.**

**Triage call:** Builds on #125 Texas RRC adapter work. Could be a worthwhile extension once #271 (output_dir wiring) and the texas_rrc adapter are operational. Recommendation: **scope** as a follow-on after texas_rrc adapter ships.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/127)

### #128 — `WRK-1231: Implement CompanyLoader for BOEM company/operator hierarchy`
> Mission: Create CompanyLoader for BSEE company data. **Binary files already exist** (`mv_companies_active.bin`), download URL registered, but no loader. **Complexity: medium, Priority: high.**

**Triage call:** This is **the most actionable** in the batch — data already on disk, just needs a loader class. Clean unit-test surface. Recommendation: **approve and implement** — small, self-contained, high-leverage (unlocks operator hierarchy queries).
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/128)

### #129 — `WRK-1234: BOEM/BSEE data refresh CLI script`
> Mission: CLI script to refresh BOEM/BSEE binary data using 129 url_registry specs. 9 of 129 specs have empty local cache.

**Triage call:** Has plan from yesterday (`docs/plans/2026-05-04-issue-129-boem-bsee-cli-refresh.md`). Plan recommends checking if `scripts/refresh_bsee_all.py` already exists — if yes, mostly done. Recommendation: **approve to implement** — the plan is concrete and short.
[View issue](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/worldenergydata/issues/129)

- **Defer or close as superseded:** #125, #126, #127 (need detailed scoping or credentials)
